definitions.explanation: The gradual building up of something over time, typically debts, deficits, data, fatigue, or other quantities that keep adding up. Often implies a negative buildup.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{累積|るいせき}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{累積|るいせき}⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{膨大|ぼうだい}→膨大：08997_boudai⟧な⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: The accumulated debt has reached an enormous amount.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疲労|ひろう}→疲労：13603_hirou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{累積|るいせき}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}した→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧。
examples.english: Years of accumulated fatigue broke down my body.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used with negative quantities — debts, deficits, losses, fatigue. Also used in neutral/technical contexts like {累積|るいせき}⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧ (cumulative data) and {累積|るいせき}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (cumulative sales figures). Common in finance, business, and statistics.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{蓄積|ちくせき}→蓄積：14023_chikuseki⟧: accumulation, storage (more positive, for knowledge, experience)
- {集積|しゅうせき}: aggregation, concentration (clustering together)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {累積|るいせき}⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧: accumulated deficit
- {累積|るいせき}⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧: accumulated debt
- {累積|るいせき}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: cumulative sales figures
- ⟦{疲労|ひろう}→疲労：13603_hirou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{累積|るいせき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: fatigue accumulates
